# Transform Geometry

Moves, rotates and resizes the whole geometry together.

`lfs.transform_geometry` · Geometry

## How to use

Start with Translation for a move or Scale 1 to keep the original size.  
Rotation uses degrees around the object's origin.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Translation | `Translation` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01 | Movement along X, Y and Z in scene units. (0, 0, 0), the default, leaves positions unchanged. |
| Rotation | `Rotation` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 1 | Rotation around X, Y and Z in degrees. The default (0, 0, 0) leaves the orientation unchanged. |
| Scale | `Scale` | lfs.float | 1 | step 0.01 | Size multiplier. 1 keeps the original size, 0 collapses it to the origin; negative values mirror it. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |
